can_do: I can point to and say weather words.
kp_target: VOC: weather words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
lesson_input: Look at the weather window. Point to the weather. Say one word: sunny, rainy, windy, or cloudy. | Model: sunny / rainy / windy / cloudy
repair_link: Point to one weather picture. Say the weather word.

can_do: I can say It's sunny and It's rainy.
kp_target: CHK: It's ...; VOC: sunny/rainy; RDG/LST: simple sentence recognition
lesson_input: Look outside. Use the chunk It's ... with sunny or rainy. | Model: It's sunny. / It's rainy.
repair_link: Choose one window picture. Say: It's sunny. or It's rainy.

can_do: I can say It's windy and It's cloudy.
kp_target: CHK: It's ...; VOC: windy/cloudy; LST/RDG weather recognition
lesson_input: Look for moving leaves for windy. Look for many clouds for cloudy. | Model: It's windy. / It's cloudy.
repair_link: Point to the window. Say: It's windy. or It's cloudy.

kp_target: VOC: clothes words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
lesson_input: Look at the clothes. Point and say one clothes word. | Model: coat / hat / boots / T-shirt / shoes / umbrella / jacket / sweater
repair_link: Choose one clothes picture. Say the clothes word.

can_do: I can choose clothes for the weather.
kp_target: MED: choose for weather; CHK: Choose ...; VOC weather/clothes
lesson_input: Look at the weather. Choose one or two clothes items. | Model: Sunny day: choose a hat. / Rainy day: choose boots. / Rainy day: choose an umbrella.
repair_link: Look at one weather picture. Choose clothes for it.

can_do: I can help a friend choose clothes.
kp_target: SI/MED: help a friend; CHK: Choose ... for ...; review weather/clothes
lesson_input: A friend looks at the weather. Help with one short choice. | Model: It's rainy. Choose boots. / It's sunny. Choose a hat. / It's windy. Choose a jacket.
repair_link: Help Mia, Leo, or Emma. Say one short choice.

can_do: I can make a simple weather choice card.
kp_target: PRJ: Weather Choice Card; SP/WRT: short project model; review It's ... + choose ...
lesson_input: A weather choice card has one weather picture and matching clothes pictures. | Model: It's rainy. Choose boots. Choose an umbrella. / It's sunny. Choose a hat.
repair_link: Make your card. Say the weather and one clothes choice.

can_do: I can understand a short weather-and-clothes story.
kp_target: LST: main idea/detail; VOC weather/clothes; CHK It's ... / Choose ...
repair_link: Replay / reread Watch lines and match weather to clothes.

can_do: I can make and share a Weather Choice Card.
kp_target: PRJ: weather picture + clothes pictures + short spoken chunk
lesson_input: Project model card and phrase bank
repair_link: Use IMG18/IMG19 and one short sentence frame.
